title: Summit designation, route generation, vista selection
summary: Generate the goals: designate the highest validated-reachable plantable point as the summit, generate two or three routes of per-environment rising difficulty structured introduce→develop→twist→resolve (beat 1 = T0 ground set only; the twist is the signature/tool beat), and pick three vistas scored for view. Traversal tools (grapple/pole-vault/wall-run) may be required to reach the summit only when the required tool is taught in an earlier beat of that route, never beat 1. Each route records a difficulty score and a global difficulty score as metadata (SPEC §3.4).

acceptance_tests.test: For a corpus environment the service designates a reachable summit, generates 2–3 routes of rising per-environment difficulty (each with a per-segment beat, a difficulty score, and a global difficulty score), and selects 3 vistas scored for view (viewshed/framing/low-to-moderate-difficulty access/spatial spread), all written to environment_spec.json.

Beat 1 of every route uses only the T0 set — walk, jog, run, jump, step-up, hop-over, mantle (Bible §10); three generation retries with relaxed shaping (never a relaxed margin), then a template fallback that is a single guaranteed-simple validated route so the environment is never a dead end.
On 10 corpus rooms, a reachable summit and at least two valid routes are produced with no manual fixes on 8 or more.

A route may require a traversal tool (grapple/pole-vault/wall-run) to reach the summit only if that tool is introduced in an earlier beat of the same route; no tool appears in beat 1. The validator (M1-SCEN-05) enforces this.
acceptance_tests.evidence: validator report + a tool-required corpus room

history.event: sharpened under AUTH #023 (journey generation v1): per-environment rising difficulty + per-route difficulty score and global difficulty score; beat 1 = T0 set with the twist as the signature/tool beat; vista scoring criteria; template fallback = one guaranteed-simple validated route; tools may be required to summit only if taught in an earlier beat, never beat 1 (AT-5).
